sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fuel Shortage is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Sometimes I think back to how the locals welcomed us when we first entered Tarkov. We thought the mission would be brief, but things did not go according to plan. We are currently facing shortages of supplies and fuel-related materials. Our deliveries have been disrupted, and the locals are no longer willing to assist us. We need your help, mercenary."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over 5 items from the category with the Found in raid status
- Hand over 5 items from the category with the Found in raid status

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Everything collected? Splendid! Dziękuję, mercenary."
